test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - General Knowledge and General Awareness (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which schedule of the Constitution of India contains provisions for disqualification of legislator on the ground of defection?
solution:
correct answer is__** Schedule-X.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Parliament added it to the Constitution as the **Tenth Schedule.**
 
• In** 1985** in order to **bring stability to governments** by discouraging legislators from changing parties.
 
• The Tenth Schedule - popularly known as the Anti-Defe
